project.title: Quality-Critical Azure Lakehouse
project.subtitle: From batch and streaming telemetry to governed data products
project.author: Michael Seth Williams
project.business_problem: Operations leaders need one trustworthy path from batch quality observations and sensor telemetry to traceable decisions, without hiding rejected data, history, failures, or operating cost.
project.recruiter_takeaway: I engineered a reproducible Azure lakehouse that makes ingestion, quality, history, orchestration, recovery, performance, governance, monitoring, cost, and teardown independently inspectable.

hero_path.title: Two ingestion modes, one governed data product
hero_path.what: I designed a bounded batch and streaming path through ADF, Event Hubs, ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks, Delta, and Unity Catalog.
hero_path.why: The diagram makes service purpose, trust boundaries, storage layers, and operating controls legible in one view.

hero_path.title: Reusable PySpark with explicit quality routing
hero_path.what: I separated Bronze provenance, Silver conformance, quarantine, temporal history, and Gold publication into tested modules.
hero_path.why: Thin entrypoints and deterministic contracts make the logic reviewable, rerunnable, and safe to evolve.

hero_path.title: A dependency-aware Lakeflow Jobs DAG
hero_path.what: I defined preflight, landing verification, parallel batch and stream ingestion, quality gates, Silver and SCD2 paths, Gold, validation, and evidence receipt tasks.
hero_path.why: Task dependencies isolate failures and enable repair without repeating successful upstream work.

hero_path.title: Lineage designed into table operations
hero_path.what: I use catalog-qualified table operations, explicit object ownership, comments, tags, and scoped grants to preserve inspectable lineage.
hero_path.why: A recruiter can trace Gold outputs back through Silver and Bronze rather than accept a diagram as proof.

hero_path.title: Controlled failure, focused repair, deterministic recovery
hero_path.what: I reserve one hard contract violation, capture the failed task, repair only the affected path, and compare clean and recovered hashes.
hero_path.why: The incident demonstrates operational judgment, not just a successful happy path.

hero_path.title: Three-by-three Spark measurement without cherry-picking
hero_path.what: I ran three baseline and three optimized executions on the same compute using a separate five-million-row skewed fixture.
hero_path.why: The broadcast plan was 39.009% slower by median wall time, and I published that result instead of selecting a favorable run. Spark Connect's unavailable task metrics remain explicit.

engineering_journey.title: Quality and quarantine

engineering_journey.title: Silver conformance

engineering_journey.title: CDC and SCD Type 2

engineering_journey.title: Gold data products

engineering_journey.title: Lakeflow orchestration
engineering_journey.summary: The complete ten-task dependency graph succeeded on bounded ephemeral Trial compute.

engineering_journey.title: Lineage
engineering_journey.summary: Unity Catalog recorded live table and column lineage from conformed quality data into Gold outputs.

engineering_journey.title: Failure and recovery
engineering_journey.summary: A reserved hard failure stopped the real quality gate; focused repair preserved successful upstream work and reproduced clean hashes.

engineering_journey.title: Performance
engineering_journey.summary: Six five-million-row runs showed the broadcast plan was 39.009% slower by median wall time; result hashes matched and unavailable Spark Connect status-store metrics are explicit.

engineering_journey.title: Monitoring and cost
engineering_journey.summary: Diagnostics and the alert rule were configured; the data-plane incident did not fire the control-plane alert, Log Analytics had no visible rows in-window, and cost remained pending settlement.

engineering_journey.title: CI/CD
engineering_journey.summary: Local, security, IaC, bundle, publication, Pages, and a resource-group-scoped OIDC deployment validation protect release quality.

engineering_journey.title: Verified teardown
engineering_journey.summary: Azure confirmed the isolated resource group, Databricks-managed resource group, and Part 4 budget absent after exact-scope deletion and 20 authoritative polls.

engineering_journey.title: Evidence methodology
engineering_journey.summary: Every major claim binds platform capture, code, receipt, validation, UTC time, commit, and SHA-256.

architecture_decisions.title: Split ingestion by workload shape
architecture_decisions.context: Batch quality files and telemetry events have different operating semantics, evidence needs, and recovery states.
architecture_decisions.decision: ADF owns bounded file movement while Event Hubs and Structured Streaming own event ingress; both paths converge in Bronze.
architecture_decisions.rejected_alternative: Force all ingestion through ADF, force all ingestion through Event Hubs, or hide both patterns inside Databricks-only jobs.
architecture_decisions.tradeoff: Two ingress control planes require more operational discipline than one, but they expose workload-appropriate metrics, offsets, file counts, row counts, and recovery state.
architecture_decisions.outcome: Six ADF Copy activities reconciled 30,000 rows, and Event Hubs plus checkpointed streaming reconciled exactly 20,000 messages.
architecture_decisions.production_extension: A production implementation would add formal source onboarding standards, data-sharing contracts, and workload-specific SLAs for each ingress mode.
architecture_decisions.reconsider_when: Reconsider if source volume, latency, enterprise ingestion standards, or the cost of two ingress planes changes enough to outweigh workload separation.

architecture_decisions.title: Preserve source fidelity before conformance
architecture_decisions.context: Quality-critical investigation requires replayable source records before business interpretation changes fields, units, or keys.
architecture_decisions.decision: Use an append-only, source-fidelity Bronze preservation contract with source identity, timestamps, run ID, record hash, and schema version.
architecture_decisions.rejected_alternative: Transform in landing, write directly to Silver, or retain files without a Bronze Delta representation.
architecture_decisions.tradeoff: More metadata and storage are retained, but audit, replay, incident diagnosis, and reproducibility become stronger.
architecture_decisions.outcome: Executed Bronze tables preserve the provenance fields needed to trace later Silver, quarantine, history, and Gold outputs.
architecture_decisions.production_extension: Production would add formal retention, deletion, privacy, and classification policy rather than implying indefinite retention.
architecture_decisions.reconsider_when: Reconsider if legal deletion, privacy, retention, or storage policy makes full source-fidelity retention inappropriate.

architecture_decisions.title: Apply risk-based quality policies
architecture_decisions.context: Different data defects have different business consequences, so one blanket validation behavior would either hide risk or stop useful work unnecessarily.
architecture_decisions.decision: Implement observe/allow, reason-coded quarantine, and hard fail as explicit business quality policies.
architecture_decisions.rejected_alternative: Drop every invalid row, fail on every defect, or allow all records and report issues after publication.
architecture_decisions.tradeoff: The policy needs more contract design and routing logic, but it avoids silent corruption and gratuitously brittle pipelines.
architecture_decisions.outcome: Lakeflow expectation metrics, quarantine routing, and a real reserved hard-failure contract were all exercised.
architecture_decisions.production_extension: Production would add contract ownership, schema-change governance, remediation queues, and stewardship workflows.
architecture_decisions.reconsider_when: Reconsider if producers formally guarantee contracts or if manual quarantine remediation costs more than its risk reduction.

architecture_decisions.title: Use declarative temporal history with an honest fallback
architecture_decisions.context: Batch lifecycle changes need effective-dated history without asking consumers to reconstruct state from raw events.
architecture_decisions.decision: Use Lakeflow AUTO CDC for the executed SCD Type 2 path and keep deterministic Delta MERGE documented only as a fallback.
architecture_decisions.rejected_alternative: Hand-code Delta MERGE for the executed path, overwrite current state only, or make every consumer rebuild history from events.
architecture_decisions.tradeoff: AUTO CDC reduces custom sequencing and SCD machinery, but it couples the executed history path to Databricks declarative semantics.
architecture_decisions.outcome: The live CHANGE flow produced 647 effective-dated rows and passed the one-current-version invariant; the MERGE fallback was not used.
architecture_decisions.production_extension: Production would define portability requirements, history retention, late-arriving-change policy, and cross-platform fallback criteria.
architecture_decisions.reconsider_when: Reconsider if portability away from Lakeflow, unsupported temporal semantics, or deterministic cross-platform execution becomes more important than reduced code.

architecture_decisions.title: Build governance into named table operations
architecture_decisions.context: The portfolio needs access control, discoverability, and lineage to be part of the data path, not a diagram added after processing.
architecture_decisions.decision: Use catalog-qualified table operations, ownership, grants, comments, tags, masking, and Unity Catalog lineage for governed objects.
architecture_decisions.rejected_alternative: Default to arbitrary path-based Delta access, govern only downstream assets, or document lineage manually.
architecture_decisions.tradeoff: The design requires stronger namespace, ownership, and permission discipline, but it makes governance and lineage inspectable at runtime.
architecture_decisions.outcome: Unity Catalog recorded governed objects, access controls, tags, masking, table lineage, and column lineage for the executed path.
architecture_decisions.production_extension: Production would add organization-level ownership, policy enforcement, environment separation, and access-review procedures.
architecture_decisions.reconsider_when: Reconsider only for explicit interoperability exceptions that cannot consume governed tables; exceptions should not become path access by habit.

architecture_decisions.title: Measure performance instead of assuming optimization
architecture_decisions.context: A portfolio performance claim is only useful when the experiment can reject an attractive optimization idea.
architecture_decisions.decision: Run a separate five-million-row fixture three times per implementation on the same compute and publish the median result.
architecture_decisions.rejected_alternative: Broadcast because the dimension is small, choose the fastest individual run, or imply scale from the small business fixture.
architecture_decisions.tradeoff: Controlled benchmarking consumes time and may invalidate a design idea, but it prevents intuition from being presented as proof.
architecture_decisions.outcome: The broadcast plan matched result hashes but was 39.009% slower by median wall time; no causal explanation is claimed because task-level metrics were unavailable.
architecture_decisions.production_extension: Production would add representative concurrency, runtime telemetry, regression thresholds, and workload SLAs.
architecture_decisions.reconsider_when: Reconsider whenever data size, skew, runtime, partitioning, topology, concurrency, or service objectives materially change.

execution_timeline.title: Bound cost and identity
execution_timeline.outcome: The build began with deterministic fixtures, cost stop rules, scoped identity, and fail-closed automation.

execution_timeline.title: Provision and reconcile Azure resources
execution_timeline.outcome: Modular Bicep deployed the isolated Trial-only resource set and reconciled it against the expected inventory.

execution_timeline.title: Land batch files and stream telemetry
execution_timeline.outcome: ADF landed six commit-pinned files while Event Hubs and Structured Streaming reconciled bounded telemetry.

execution_timeline.title: Preserve Bronze provenance and checkpoints
execution_timeline.outcome: Source metadata, run identity, schema version, record hashes, streaming offsets, and checkpoints were retained before conformance.

execution_timeline.title: Conform, quarantine, and maintain history
execution_timeline.outcome: Silver validation, reason-coded quarantine, fail-on-violation behavior, and AUTO CDC history created the analytical boundary.

execution_timeline.title: Publish governed Gold products and lineage
execution_timeline.outcome: Six Gold products were published through catalog-qualified operations with grain, keys, validation SQL, and lineage.

execution_timeline.title: Inject failure, repair, and measure performance
execution_timeline.outcome: A real hard quality failure was repaired with matching recovered hashes, and the proposed Spark optimization was rejected by measurement.

execution_timeline.title: Validate release and prove teardown
execution_timeline.outcome: CI, Pages, evidence artifacts, PDF validation, and authoritative Azure absence closed the lifecycle.

production_readiness.executed_proof: The bounded portfolio used isolated resource groups, scoped identities, disabled shared storage keys, and exact teardown scope.
production_readiness.production_extension: Add private endpoints, firewall restrictions, VNet-integrated workspaces, environment separation, and policy enforcement.

production_readiness.executed_proof: Trial compute processed the bounded workload and the separate five-million-row fixture under the same measured configuration.
production_readiness.production_extension: Add representative concurrency, production node sizing, throughput SLAs, autoscaling policy, and regression thresholds.

production_readiness.executed_proof: Diagnostics and the alert rule were configured before workloads; limitations for empty in-window logs and unfired alert state remain explicit.
production_readiness.production_extension: Add routed alerting, operational dashboards, longer retention, error budgets, and on-call ownership.

production_readiness.executed_proof: The real quality gate failed, the affected path was repaired, and recovered counts, invariants, aggregates, and hashes reconciled.
production_readiness.production_extension: Define formal SLOs, RPO/RTO, backup/restore exercises, regional strategy, and recurring failure tests.

production_readiness.executed_proof: Managed identities, Access Connector, scoped grants, ownership, comments, tags, masking, and lineage were exercised.
production_readiness.production_extension: Add privileged-access processes, access reviews, enterprise policy assignments, customer-managed keys where required, and ownership workflow.

production_readiness.executed_proof: Budget notifications, engineering stop gates, ephemeral compute, CI/CD validation, and exact-scope teardown bounded the lifecycle.
production_readiness.production_extension: Add chargeback tags, forecasting, anomaly response, promotion controls, and long-lived capacity planning.

future_consumer_boundary.title: Governed Gold boundary for future consumers
future_consumer_boundary.statement: Future AI Engineering Portfolio consumers enter through governed Gold data products; that future portfolio is not implemented in Part 4.
future_consumer_boundary.interface_rule: Consumers inherit table identity, grain, keys, schema expectations, quality boundary, temporal semantics, lineage, ownership, and access controls without bypassing Bronze, Silver, quarantine, or SCD2 contracts.

pdf_pages.title: Quality-Critical Azure Lakehouse
pdf_pages.statement: From batch and streaming telemetry to governed, traceable data products.

pdf_pages.title: Trust has to survive the whole data path
pdf_pages.statement: Operations needs to know whether a batch stayed within limits, what changed, which records failed, and where every KPI originated.

pdf_pages.title: Two ingestion modes. One governed lakehouse.
pdf_pages.statement: ADF lands deterministic batch files while Event Hubs feeds bounded telemetry into checkpointed Structured Streaming.

pdf_pages.title: Architecture decisions make the Azure build defensible
pdf_pages.statement: Six choices expose the context, rejected alternative, accepted trade-off, executed evidence, and reconsideration trigger.

pdf_pages.title: Trial-only infrastructure with fail-closed cost gates
pdf_pages.statement: Subscription-scope Bicep deployed the isolated resource group and reconciled Azure service set after a sanitized what-if.

pdf_pages.title: Managed identity is the default trust path
pdf_pages.statement: ADF, the Access Connector, and federated deployment automation used scoped access without long-lived cloud passwords.

pdf_pages.title: ADLS Gen2 separates landing, checkpoints, quarantine, and evidence
pdf_pages.statement: Hierarchical namespace, TLS 1.2, disabled shared keys, and executed paths make state and ownership clear.

pdf_pages.title: ADF ingested six commit-pinned source files
pdf_pages.statement: The executed ForEach and Copy pattern preserves file-level transfer and activity evidence.

pdf_pages.title: Six files and 30,000 rows reconcile
pdf_pages.statement: The ADF run binds six successful Copy activities to 30,000 landed rows and byte-level receipts.

pdf_pages.title: Twenty thousand deterministic telemetry messages
pdf_pages.statement: Azure Monitor, the bounded producer receipt, final offsets, and Bronze rows all reconcile to 20,000.

pdf_pages.title: Explicit schema, checkpoint, metadata, append semantics
pdf_pages.statement: Event Hubs ingress, final offsets, zero lag, checkpoint state, and Bronze Delta counts reconcile.

pdf_pages.title: Governance belongs inside the data path
pdf_pages.statement: Catalog-qualified objects, managed storage, ownership, grants, tags, comments, masking, and external locations were applied.

pdf_pages.title: Raw does not mean unaccountable
pdf_pages.statement: Executed Bronze tables preserve source, timestamps, pipeline run, record hash, and schema version.

pdf_pages.title: Allow, quarantine, and fail are different decisions
pdf_pages.statement: Lakeflow published expectation metrics, routed rejected rows, and enforced one real fail-on-violation contract.

pdf_pages.title: Bad records stay explainable
pdf_pages.statement: Six quality rows and 17,144 telemetry rows remained reason-coded and inspectable rather than disappearing.

pdf_pages.title: Conformance creates a dependable analytical boundary
pdf_pages.statement: Explicit types, keys, units, domains, joins, deduplication, and idempotency shaped the executed Silver tables.

pdf_pages.title: AUTO CDC preserves history instead of overwriting it
pdf_pages.statement: The Lakeflow CHANGE flow upserted 647 effective-dated rows and passed the one-current-version invariant.

pdf_pages.title: Six outputs with explicit business grain
pdf_pages.statement: Two facts, three dimensions, and a site-product-date KPI table were published and validated.

pdf_pages.title: Executed lifecycle from cost boundary to teardown
pdf_pages.statement: The build follows eight evidence-linked stages: bound, provision, ingest, preserve, conform, publish, break/repair/measure, and close.

pdf_pages.title: Gold is traceable to conformed source data
pdf_pages.statement: Unity Catalog recorded the live relationship from Silver batch quality into the Gold fact and downstream consumers.

pdf_pages.title: Traceability reaches the field level
pdf_pages.statement: The selected path maps Silver result_value into Gold result_value and its derived quality_pass flag.

pdf_pages.title: A reserved hard violation broke the real task
pdf_pages.statement: The deterministic incident failed the live quality gate on reserved_schema_contract and HARD-FAIL-0001.

pdf_pages.title: The platform named the violated contract
pdf_pages.statement: The diagnostic connected schema version 99.0-reserved-failure to the affected quality flow and input record.

pdf_pages.title: Repair the failed path, preserve completed work
pdf_pages.statement: Lakeflow repair reran Bronze batch and dependent tasks while successful landing and streaming tasks remained one-attempt work.

pdf_pages.title: Recovery is verified by content, not appearance
pdf_pages.statement: Counts, duplicates, aggregates, current-version checks, and clean-versus-recovered hashes all reconciled.

pdf_pages.title: A separate five-million-row fixture creates an honest test
pdf_pages.statement: Three baseline runs recorded wall time and plan hashes; Spark Connect did not expose classic task and shuffle status-store metrics.

pdf_pages.title: The justified optimization was slower
pdf_pages.statement: Three broadcast runs matched result hashes but were 39.009% slower by median wall time on the same compute.

pdf_pages.title: Configuration and observed outcomes stay distinct
pdf_pages.statement: Diagnostics preceded workloads; no Log Analytics rows were visible in-window, and the data-plane failure did not fire the control-plane alert.

pdf_pages.title: Production readiness separates proof from extension
pdf_pages.statement: Six readiness rows distinguish executed portfolio proof from enterprise hardening work labeled PRODUCTION_BLUEPRINT.

pdf_pages.title: Every release travels through validation
pdf_pages.statement: Python, Spark, Bicep, bundle, content, accessibility, secret, metadata, PDF, Pages, and OIDC checks protect publication.

pdf_pages.title: The lifecycle ends with authoritative absence
pdf_pages.statement: Azure confirmed both isolated resource groups and the Part 4 budget absent after 20 polls; the shared metastore and unrelated resources were preserved.

pdf_pages.title: Future AI Engineering Portfolio starts at governed Gold
pdf_pages.statement: The future consumer boundary defines table identity, grain, keys, quality, temporal semantics, lineage, ownership, and access; it is not implemented in Part 4.
